title: Fractional squeezing: spectra and dynamics from generalized squeezing Hamiltonian with fractional orders
summary: We generalize the generalized-squeezing problem to include fractional values of the squeezing order $n$. This approach allows us to determine the locations of critical points at which qualitative changes in behaviour occur and accurately predict the behaviour at these critical points, which are challenging for conventional computational methods.
